query:
WITH pins AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT value p FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details#>'{census,0,input_manifest}') WHERE event_id=108430),
metrics AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT m.* FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_metric_v1 m JOIN pins ON m.document_key=p->>'document_key' WHERE m.record->>'state' LIKE '%CONFLICT%'),
facts AS(SELECT m.document_key,m.metric,m.metric_key,m.record_sha256 metric_sha,i.value input_pin,f.ordinal,f.record_sha256 fact_sha,f.payload
FROM metrics m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.record->'input_facts') i(value) LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_fact_v1 f ON f.document_key=m.document_key AND f.ordinal=(i.value->>'ordinal')::bigint)
SELECT document_key,metric,metric_key,metric_sha,count(*) fact_count,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE fact_sha IS DISTINCT FROM input_pin->>'record_sha256' OR fact_sha IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) hash_errors,
jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ordinal',ordinal,'fact_sha',fact_sha,'value_text',payload->>'value','source_decimals',payload->>'source_decimals','identity',jsonb_build_array(payload->>'canonical_concept',payload->>'taxonomy_uri',payload->>'entity_cik',payload->>'entity_scheme',payload->>'context_sha256',payload->>'unit_sha256',payload->>'unit',payload->>'period_kind',payload->>'period_start',payload->>'period_end'),'dimension_count',payload->>'dimension_count','extraction_state',payload->>'extraction_state') ORDER BY ordinal) facts FROM facts GROUP BY document_key,metric,metric_key,metric_sha ORDER BY document_key,metric,metric_key;
pin_query:
WITH pins AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT value p FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details#>'{census,0,input_manifest}') WHERE event_id=108430)
SELECT count(*) pinned_documents,count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.derived_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'derived_sha256' OR a.manifest_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'admission_sha256') changed_pins,
(SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_metric_v1 m JOIN pins ON m.document_key=p->>'document_key' WHERE m.record->>'state' LIKE '%CONFLICT%' AND m.record_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(m.record::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) metric_hash_errors
FROM pins LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_document_v1 d ON d.document_key=p->>'document_key' LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_admission_v1 a ON a.document_key=p->>'document_key';
independent_numeric_sql:
WITH groups AS MATERIALIZED(WITH pins AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT value p FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details#>'{census,0,input_manifest}') WHERE event_id=108430),
metrics AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT m.* FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_metric_v1 m JOIN pins ON m.document_key=p->>'document_key' WHERE m.record->>'state' LIKE '%CONFLICT%'),
facts AS(SELECT m.document_key,m.metric,m.metric_key,m.record_sha256 metric_sha,i.value input_pin,f.ordinal,f.record_sha256 fact_sha,f.payload
FROM metrics m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.record->'input_facts') i(value) LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_fact_v1 f ON f.document_key=m.document_key AND f.ordinal=(i.value->>'ordinal')::bigint)
SELECT document_key,metric,metric_key,metric_sha,count(*) fact_count,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE fact_sha IS DISTINCT FROM input_pin->>'record_sha256' OR fact_sha IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) hash_errors,
jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ordinal',ordinal,'fact_sha',fact_sha,'value_text',payload->>'value','source_decimals',payload->>'source_decimals','identity',jsonb_build_array(payload->>'canonical_concept',payload->>'taxonomy_uri',payload->>'entity_cik',payload->>'entity_scheme',payload->>'context_sha256',payload->>'unit_sha256',payload->>'unit',payload->>'period_kind',payload->>'period_start',payload->>'period_end'),'dimension_count',payload->>'dimension_count','extraction_state',payload->>'extraction_state') ORDER BY ordinal) facts FROM facts GROUP BY document_key,metric,metric_key,metric_sha ORDER BY document_key,metric,metric_key),
f AS(SELECT g.document_key,g.metric_key,x.value fact,(x.value->>'value_text')::numeric v,CASE WHEN x.value->>'source_decimals'='INF' THEN 1001 ELSE (x.value->>'source_decimals')::int END d FROM groups g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g.facts) x(value)),
accuracy AS(SELECT document_key,metric_key,d,count(DISTINCT v) n FROM f GROUP BY 1,2,3),
bounds AS(SELECT document_key,metric_key,count(*) n,count(DISTINCT fact->'identity') identities,max(v-CASE WHEN d=1001 THEN 0 ELSE power(10::numeric,-d)/2 END) lo,min(v+CASE WHEN d=1001 THEN 0 ELSE power(10::numeric,-d)/2 END) hi,count(*) FILTER(WHERE fact->>'dimension_count' IS DISTINCT FROM '0' OR fact->>'extraction_state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PARSED') ineligible FROM f GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) groups_checked,count(*) FILTER(WHERE identities<>1 OR ineligible>0 OR lo>hi OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accuracy a WHERE a.document_key=b.document_key AND a.metric_key=b.metric_key AND a.n>1)) rejected,
sum(n) facts_checked,encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(jsonb_build_array(document_key,metric_key,n,identities,lo,hi,ineligible)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY document_key,metric_key),'UTF8')),'hex') interval_manifest_sha256 FROM bounds b;
